Metalwork is never magenta or pink. Nothing may touch or be cropped by the canvas edge. Render at the maximum available output resolution. Clearly articulate chimney mouths, forge apertures, gantry joints, and any banner poles for future motion. The gopher face must remain architectural, not a printed badge.
